meta.source: openICPSR 100707 - UCR Offenses Known and Clearances by Arrest (Return A), 1960-2024
meta.caveat: County figures are summed from agency reports. Overlapping jurisdictions and non-reporting agencies distort them; see https://ucrbook.com/county-level-data.html. Agencies covering more than one county are split by population share. Agencies whose crime is filed by a parent agency count as covered, not as missing. Agencies with no county of their own are routed to the counties they file for. `cov` is the share of population that reported and is never used to rescale a rate; `imp` is the share of offences that were allocated or estimated rather than filed for that county. Aggravated assault is the aggravated column only. Violent and property totals are summed from their components.
